channel.title: The Steve Wilkos Show
channel.desc: Naika, 14, tragically lost her life after posting a disturbing livestream online; now, authorities suspect that her mother, Gina, may have contributed to the emotional turmoil that led to this devastating outcome. Gina insists she loved her daughter deeply and says she's being unfairly portrayed as someone who pushed her child too far.
